limits: Exact original make command/CI tool versions, assertions and deadlines, with compile-time-gated WORK diagnostic logging only. No CLEAN required-CI, native, shipping or performance admission.
Cold product target enforced; original make builds bootstrap/download dependencies as CI normally does. Full pre-build consumed-provider/dependency sealing is NOT established by this runner.
Selected module hashes are after-command outputs; module payload is not retained or independently hashed at runtime. Process owner artifact is make, not the wasm module.
Failed original make may stop before host assertions; read raw logs before attributing any product cause.
Exact consumed source endpoint requires source_full. If sourceafter failed, only source-before/protocol/tool/process provenance is authenticated, no exact-source typing/product claim.

WORK compile-time observer has extra log awaits/retained observation state. No performance or uninstrumented timing acceptance; no full pre-build consumed-provider/dependency seal. Original make can bootstrap dependencies.

This author validated exact tracked membership and current roster and driver/workflow critical Git payloads, not every Git blob. Owner artifact is make, module payload absent; no running-module independent identity proof.
Separate original browser/WASI commands and supplemental unit. Each remains independent; no host/collision closure follows from the unit.
